title: Layout
description: auto follows the page's shape: wider than 2:1 lays out as a band (the strip beside the dash share, for the top or bottom edge), otherwise as a column (dash share above the strip, for the side columns). Size the page in your host; type and graphics scale with it.

title: Alignment
description: Which side the dash share sits on in the band layout (right puts it on the screen-edge side when the band hugs the right), and the corner the status line uses.

title: Motion
description: full = values ease, events flash (the catcher's dash fades back, a new favourite spot lights amber). reduced = values and enter/exit still ease; no pulses, flashes or kiai ambience. off = everything instant.

title: Backing
description: scrim = a dark field with soft edges that keeps small text readable on bright maps. panel = a solid graphite panel. none = text straight on the game with a contrast shadow; only for a dimmed background.

title: Heatmap bins
description: How many columns the playfield is split into. Fewer bins read as broad zones, more show fine positioning. Changes apply to the whole attempt instantly.

title: Colour intensity
description: Brightness curve of the heat shades, 0.25–4. 1 is linear; higher values lift rarely visited zones, lower values keep only the hottest spots bright. Bar heights stay linear.

title: Show catcher marker
description: Draw the live catcher in amber (its true catch range for the map's CS, filled while dashing) and its position line during play.

title: Show on results
description: Keep the finished attempt's heatmap on the results screen; osu! never shows where the catcher spent its time. Off: the overlay is empty on results.
